SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT SEQ , CENTER_CD , PO_NO , PUR_LINE_NUM FROM SAMYANGGROUP_PO_IF_R WHERE SEND_YN = 'N' ORDER BY CENTER_CD, PO_NO, PUR_LINE_NUM, SEQ
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'SYGP' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, PROC_TYPE AS STATUS, CENTER_CD AS PLANT, rtrim(ERP_COMP_CD)+'OP'+PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO, PUR_LINE_NUM AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, ISNULL(ITM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, 'KRW' AS CURRENCY_CODE, ISNULL(PUR_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, ISNULL(PUR_QTY,0) AS ITEM_QTY, 0 AS ITEM_AMT, ISNULL(PUR_DT,' ') AS ADD_DATE, ISNULL(LIM_DLV_REQ_DT,' ') AS RD_DATE, ISNULl(CENTER_CD ,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, ISNULL(RCV_ADDR,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT, ISNULL(PUR_NM,' ') AS PURCHASER_USER_ID, ISNULL(ERP_RFX_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_PR_NO, ISNULL(RCV_NM,' ') AS REQ_USER_NAME, ISNULL(RCV_DP_NM,' ') AS REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME, ISNULL(PRE_ENTER_FG,'0') AS DOC_TYPE, ISNULL(DLV_RMK,' ')+'^||^'+ISNULL(USG,' ') AS REMARK, ISNULL(INV_BUDGET_NO,' ') AS REF_IF_NO, CONVERT(varchar,SEQ) AS IV_COLUMN, ISNULL(PUR_ITM_RMK,' ') AS ERROR_MSG, ISNULL(SHIP_TO_NM,' ') AS REQ_EMAIL_NM, ISNULL(SHIP_TO_EMAIL,' ') AS REQ_EMAIL_ADD FROM SAMYANGGROUP_PO_IF_R WHERE SEQ = '$G_RS.SEQ$' AND CENTER_CD = '$G_RS.CENTER_CD$' AND PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND PUR_LINE_NUM = '$G_RS.PUR_LINE_NUM$' AND SEND_YN = 'N'
UPDATE SAMYANGGROUP_PO_IF_R SET SEND_YN = 'Y' , SEND_DT = GETDATE() WHERE SEQ = '$G_RS.SEQ$' AND CENTER_CD = '$G_RS.CENTER_CD$' AND PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND PUR_LINE_NUM = '$G_RS.PUR_LINE_NUM$' AND SEND_YN = 'N'
